notes.GLP1-020-ORTH-002:
ORTHOPEDICS — 04/29/2025

27 y/o M, 2 months of left shoulder pain with overhead reaching at work (stocking shelves). Painful arc, positive Hawkins and Neer, strength 5/5.
Dx: left shoulder subacromial impingement.
Plan: subacromial corticosteroid injection today; home exercise program for rotator cuff and scapular stabilizers (band external rotation, rows, wall slides) daily x 6 weeks; modify overhead tasks. Return 6 weeks.
notes.GLP1-020-UC-001:

notes.GLP1-020-PHARM-001:
PHARMACIST MEDICATION REVIEW — 04/02/2026

Pt asked about a pre-workout powder and ashwagandha. Pre-workout contains ~300 mg caffeine per scoop — may raise BP (on amlodipine); recommended avoiding or using half scoop. Ashwagandha: no major interaction with sertraline documented but limited data; advised to avoid combining with other sedating supplements. Pt will skip the pre-workout.
